label: gene expression up-regulation
description: a positive regulation of gene expression process that up-regulates gene expression level

label: gene expression down-regulation
description: a negative regulation process that down-regulates gene expression level

label: Fold Change
description: An indication of the magnitude difference between two values specified as the number of multiples of the first value to the second value (e.g., from 10 to 20 is a 2-fold increase, from 10 to 50 is a five-fold increase).

label: log2
description: The log base 2 value of argument X.

label: Timepoint
description: A specific point in the time continuum, including those established relative to an event.

label: Reference Time Point
description: The point in time that acts as a fixed reference point to an event.

label: Not Significant
description: A result that does not allow a researcher to conclude that differences in the data obtained for different samples are meaningful.

label: Organism
description: A living entity.

label: Gene Mapping
description: Determination of the relative positions of genes on a DNA molecule (chromosome or plasmid) and of the distance, in linkage units or physical units, between them.

label: Multiple Comparison Adjustment
description: A procedure used for correction of p-value due to multiple testing.

label: Biospecimen
description: Any material sample taken from a biological entity for testing, diagnostic, propagation, treatment or research purposes, including a sample obtained from a living organism or taken from the biological object after halting of all its life functions. Biospecimen can contain one or more components including but not limited to cellular molecules, cells, tissues, organs, body fluids, embryos, and body excretory products.

label: Genome Assembly Sequence
description: An annotated assembly of genome sequences created by the assimilation of data pieces from numerous sources.

label: Publication Identifier
description: A unique symbol that establishes identity to a publication.

label: Baseline Characteristics
description: Subject data gathered prior to an event or intervention, which may include medical history, demographic, and clinical data.

label: Data Mapping
description: The process of connecting an item or symbol to a code or concept.

label: RNA Sequencing Data File
description: An electronic file containing ribonucleic acid (RNA) sequencing data.

label: Instrument Model
description: The name and/or number associated with a specific device style or design that was developed and built to carry out a specific function or set of functions.

label: Environmental Setting
description: The environment/setting where the event, intervention, or finding occurred.

label: Differential Diagnosis Condition
description: One of a set of potential diagnoses asserted for a subject's symptoms.

label: Condition Status
description: The condition or state of the disease, disorder, injury, or other medical condition.

label: molecular_function
description: Note that, in addition to forming the root of the molecular function ontology, this term is recommended for the annotation of gene products whose molecular function is unknown. When this term is used for annotation, it indicates that no information was available about the molecular function of the gene product annotated as of the date the annotation was made; the evidence code 'no data' (ND), is used to indicate this. Despite its name, this is not a type of 'function' in the sense typically defined by upper ontologies such as Basic Formal Ontology (BFO). It is instead a BFO:process carried out by a single gene product or complex.

label: cellular_component
description: Note that, in addition to forming the root of the cellular component ontology, this term is recommended for the annotation of gene products whose cellular component is unknown. When this term is used for annotation, it indicates that no information was available about the cellular component of the gene product annotated as of the date the annotation was made; the evidence code 'no data' (ND), is used to indicate this.

label: biological_process
description: Note that, in addition to forming the root of the biological process ontology, this term is recommended for the annotation of gene products whose biological process is unknown. When this term is used for annotation, it indicates that no information was available about the biological process of the gene product annotated as of the date the annotation was made; the evidence code 'no data' (ND), is used to indicate this.

label: investigation
description: a planned process that consists of parts: planning, study design execution, documentation and which produce conclusion(s).

label: technical replicate role
description: technical replicate role is realized when two portions from one evaluant are used in replicate runs of an assay

label: protocol
description: A plan specification which has sufficient level of detail and quantitative information to communicate it between investigation agents, so that different investigation agents will reliably be able to independently reproduce the process.

label: differential expression analysis data transformation
description: A differential expression analysis data transformation is a data transformation that has an objective of differential expression analysis.  Frequently this data transformation involves summarizing or otherwise aggregating signals from various samples categorized into groups, and calculating measures of group differences from these aggregated signals.

label: RNA sequencing assay
description: An assay that determines the sequence of an RNA molecule.

label: continuous variable
description: A continuous variable is one for which, within the limits the variable ranges, any value is possible.
